brief_basis: Chart_1 labeled rating shares: Quality 36%, Price 38%, Design 34%, Support 45%, Delivery 43%, Other 53%. The highest labeled rating share is Other at 53%, so the promotional budget category should be Other. used_rules.basis: The rule states to select the category with the highest current labeled rating share. The chart's labeled values show Other at 53%, the maximum among all categories, satisfying the rule's condition.
